title: DuckNet backlog — vertical slices of one issue
description: Output of the slice chain: one oversized issue cut into independently mergeable pieces. Refusing to slice is a valid result, so `slices` may be empty when `not_sliced_because` says why.

summary.description: One to three sentences on what the issue asks for and how it was cut.

not_sliced_because.description: Present only when the issue should stay whole: it is already one sitting, or it cannot be split without leaving main unrunnable. When present, slices is empty.

order.description: 1-based position. Slices land in this order.

body.description: Markdown: what this slice does, and explicitly what it leaves for later slices.

acceptance_criteria.description: At least one must be a test or a runnable command.

touches.description: Repository-relative paths this slice is expected to change.

demo.description: What still runs after this slice lands — the command, and what it shows. Every step stays runnable.
